plan.line: a line tracking sensor module (TCRT5000): looks at a surface 1 to 15 mm in front of it and says whether it is light (reflects infrared) or dark, such as a black line on white paper. Its D0 is 0 over a light surface and 1 over black or nothing (most boards). Its A0 output isn't used.

code.pinLine: line tracking sensor {ref} on {gpio}: Pin({g}, Pin.IN). value() is 0 over a light surface that reflects infrared (white paper) and 1 over a black line or nothing, on most TCRT5000 boards (the sensitivity screw sets the switching point). It must be 1-15 mm from the surface. The module drives the line itself: no pull-up.
